archetypes.name: ballot-neutrality
archetypes.rationale: Reviewer attribution now crosses ballot construction, voting, tally, and artifact restoration.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether every voter-facing and MAV-facing ballot is neutralized before dispatch. Check that proposer-map coverage is built from the attributed source for the same round and that missing sidecar entries fail closed for neutralized blocks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-attribution
archetypes.rationale: Post-vote artifacts must restore attribution without leaking it to voters.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace accepted, rejected, OOS, classification, scoreboard, and archetype-yield outputs. Verify that scoring uses out-of-band proposer labels and audit artifacts restore reviewer lines only after voting. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
